entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: [warmly] Hey there, Cyber Hero! I've got a secret... just for you. [whispers] Come a little closer. Your password is like a magic key — and it's all yours. It's how the computer knows it's really YOU. [nervous] A weak little key? Uh-oh... that lets the sneaky Raccoon slip right in. [excited] But a big, strong one? [laughs] He doesn't stand a chance!

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: [excited] Ooh, want to know a clever trick? The longer your key, the harder it is to crack! [excited] So glue three silly words together — like otter, rocket, mango! [laughs] Long, strong, and super easy to remember!

entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: [excited] Now let's make that key SUPER tough! Mix it all up — big letters, little letters, numbers, and squiggly symbols! [nervous] A plain word like 'tiger'? The Raccoon gobbles that up in one bite. [excited] But scramble it like that — [laughs] and he's totally stumped!

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: [warmly] Okay — this is the MOST important part. Lean in close... [whispers] A password only works if you keep it secret. Don't tell your best friend. Don't leave it where anyone can peek! [warmly] The only person who ever helps is a grown-up you really trust. Deal?
